# orchestra_monitors (Data Source)

The workspace's monitors, in evaluation order. Where two monitors claim the same event, the earlier one wins. Use it to find a monitor's ID to import it, or to build an `orchestra_monitor_order`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "orchestra_monitors" "all" {}

# Monitor IDs by name, for `terraform import` or an orchestra_monitor_order.
output "monitor_ids" {
  value = { for m in data.orchestra_monitors.all.monitors : m.name => m.id }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `monitors` (Attributes List) Every monitor, earliest first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--monitors))

<a id="nestedatt--monitors"></a>
### Nested Schema for `monitors`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) The monitor description.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the monitor claims events.
- `id` (String) The monitor ID.
- `name` (String) The monitor name.
- `order` (Number) Position in the evaluation order.
